segments.name: West
segments.description: Develops, builds and sells new homes to homebuyers in Arizona, California, Nevada and Texas markets.
segments.evidence: West Segment: Net new orders for the year ended September 30, 2025 was 2,365, down 14.1% from the year ended September 30, 2024.

segments.name: East
segments.description: Develops, builds and sells new homes to homebuyers in Indiana, Maryland/Delaware, New Jersey, Tennessee and Virginia markets.
segments.evidence: East Segment: Homebuilding revenue increased by 19.0% for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025 compared to the prior fiscal year due to an 11.1% increase in closings as well as a 7.1% increase in ASP.

segments.name: Southeast
segments.description: Develops, builds and sells new homes to homebuyers in Florida, Georgia, North Carolina and South Carolina markets.
segments.evidence: The Company's entire goodwill balance is recorded in our Southeast reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Homebuyers pay Beazer for new homes, with most of them financing the purchase through third-party Choice Lenders rather than Beazer.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of our buyers either require or opt into financing to purchase a new home.
